proposals.evidence: DEDR 5160 directly gives Tamil nāṉ, Malayalam ñān, Kannada nān, Telugu nēnu, Gondi nannā/nanā/nana, Brahui ī and Toda ōn ‘I’. Each selected simple first-person pronoun is compared with its own language branch, retaining the survey’s final vowels and length notation. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
